title: Ship step forbids changing the proven commit, but a project merge how-to needs a status commit before merge
body: What happened: the ship step says to deliver the proven commit without changing it, and that any other change sends the run back to the gates. The project git how-to says to commit status: done on the ticket file on the branch before merging. Both cannot be followed: the status commit moves HEAD after the proof. Expected: warden says how to mark the ticket done at ship (for example it does it itself, or the proof allows a ticket-file-only commit). Steps: finish the check gate on a feature run, read the ship instructions, read a how-to that requires a done-status commit before merge. Evidence: ship instructions text: Deliver the proven commit without changing it ... Any other change sends the run back to the gates. I stopped before merging to avoid a gate rerun.
note: Accepted. Planned for a coming release.
